newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - ALFA STARTED AS BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ALFA STARTED AS BUY.

text.p: Caspian Securities said on Wednesday it has initiated coverage on Mexican industrial group Alfa SA de CV with a buy rating.
-- Analysts Jorge M. Beristain and Alexis Panton said in a news release that despite continued low forecast steel and chemical prices, "we believe Alfa has weathered the worst of the storm."
-- Caspian said it was impressed with strong second-quarter earnings as a record U.S. dollar performance from the chemical division Alpek complemented the steel and food divisions.

-- "Overall, Alfa's revenues increased 6.4 percent in real pesos year over year and operating margins widened 0.7 percentage points. Combined, this led to operating profit growth of 11 percent YoY (year-over-year) in real peso terms," Caspian said.
-- Revenues, operating profits and operating margins are all seen improving in the next two years.
-- Alfa shares were up 80 centavos to 64.40 pesos in early afternoon trade.
